description: This script is used as a BitBake task to create and update a Python package manifest, analyzing dependencies, handling special cases, and generating a structured JSON manifest for Python modules and files within a build system.

methods.name: isFolder
methods.description: Checks if a given path corresponds to an existing directory, considering various library directories.

methods.name: isCached
methods.description: Determines if a given filename or path indicates a cached Python bytecode directory (__pycache__).

methods.name: prepend_comments
methods.description: Prepends comments to a JSON manifest file by reading existing content and adding comments at the top.

methods.name: print_indent
methods.description: Prints a message with indentation offset for formatting output.
